design: Compact state-independent Overview heading; blue measurement hue, readout strip, animated changes, per-row real-history sparklines, mobile cards, shared crosshair and keyboard inspection, chart domain/leader/event fixes, stacked synchronized detail charts and visible metadata/recent alerts, alert episode timeline, confirmed/pending counts, reset-all confirmation, bounded date shortcuts and owner-scoped per-session report history.

scenarios.title: sign-in page is concise, responsive and explains initial password setup
overview shows three healthy motors and current units
controls show requested and applied states separately
viewers cannot see controls or request user management
reset-all polls pending controls quickly and returns to normal cadence after acknowledgement
failed refreshes cannot keep a stale command on fast polling indefinitely
offline differs from a stopped reporting motor and timeout is visible
device detail loads all charts and pagination for 24h
alerts filter by device and state with truthful email statuses
temperature report shows asynchronous result chart and CSV
vibration report shows asynchronous result chart and CSV
power report shows asynchronous result chart and CSV
reports show empty results and query failures without false success
report date window is validated before query starts
operators invite accounts and update roles while protecting self
API failures preserve visible readings and support retry
hosted sign-in uses authorization code with PKCE and random state
callback rejects a missing OAuth state and clears code from URL
session rejection and refresh failure return to sign-in
mobile navigation and dashboard have no horizontal overflow
dashboard and report form have accessible controls and landmarks
clock advancement makes old live responses visibly stale and motors offline
refresh token renewal replaces the access token after a read rejection
sign-out clears local tokens and requests the hosted logout URL
compact overview keeps a fixed heading while readings and fault indicators update
reference styling and self-hosted fonts remain usable across desktop and mobile views
alert history, team roles and report results pass accessibility checks
last-reading ages tick between polls and row sparklines use real history
fleet chart fits available data and supports shared hover, keyboard inspection and event linking
reset-all requires confirmation and cancel sends no command
mobile cards expose every metric and all navigation at 320 and 390 pixels
equipment skeleton and value changes respect reduced motion
detail charts share inspection, expose metadata and use a zero power baseline
alert timeline includes ongoing episodes that began before its visible window
report shortcuts retain query bounds and recent results reopen without new queries

constraints: No API/infrastructure/email behavior change. Report starts remain limited to seven UTC dates within 30 days; Today and Last 7 days presets do not start a query. Recent report entries reference already-started reports, are scoped to the signed-in username in session storage, and contain no tokens.
screenshotProvenance: Controlled API fixtures in docs/ui-instruments; deployed desktop/mobile screenshots are recorded separately by the real login smoke.

scenarios.title: real hosted PKCE login, current motors, live charts and protected viewer UI

deployedBrowserScope: Real desktop/operator and mobile/viewer Cognito login, three healthy motors, actual charts including 24-hour history, overview comparison and viewer access restrictions. No motor fault injection, report query, invitation email or infrastructure mutation in this smoke; disposable test accounts were cleaned up.
